claims.text: Our model outperforms existing neural extractive models on all ROUGE scores and METEOR, showing better performance than the Baseline model and previous works.
The performance significantly improves with the addition of local context, especially for long documents, indicating a clear advantage over traditional models.
The neural extractive models outperform traditional extractive models on informativeness (ROUGE-1,2) by a wide margin, although results on ROUGE-L are mixed.
